title: Ring of Fire
summary: Fight through successive grimling rounds in the Ring of Fire.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for repeated trash waves followed by stronger enemies.
Keep tanks available for the named boss at the end of each round.
Use gaps between spawns to recover and reposition before the next round.
